name: White House Serviced Residence
description: An agency-represented two-bedroom luxury residence in prime Milimani. Maintained directly by Wangwana Agency with daily housekeeping, chef-fitted kitchen, high-speed fiber connectivity, and dedicated on-site concierge.

bedroomsDetail.name: Master Suite
bedroomsDetail.features: Private Balcony Access, Wardrobe & Vanity, Blackout Drapes

bedroomsDetail.name: Second Bedroom
bedroomsDetail.features: Garden Views, Built-in Closets, Dedicated Reading Desk

policies.cancellation: 100% Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Flexible terms.
policies.deposit: No advance security deposit required. 100% Pay on Arrival guarantee.
policies.payment: M-Pesa (Till / Paybill), Cash on arrival, or Credit/Debit Card.
rules: No indoor smoking (open-air veranda and garden areas provided)
Quiet hours strictly observed 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM
No unauthorized parties or commercial shoots without prior written notice

reviews.text: Exceptional stay. The high-speed fiber internet made my remote work seamless. Pristine cleanliness and very secure compound in Milimani. Blasio was always prompt and attentive.
Traveling for a public health project in Kisumu. This was by far the best serviced apartment experience in Western Kenya. Hot water, uninterrupted power, and a fantastic kitchen.
The photos are 100% genuine. The location in Milimani is whisper-quiet yet 5 minutes from West End Mall. The pay-on-arrival option gave us complete confidence.

name: Delpiero Luxury Hilltop Villa
description: Perched upon the prestigious Riat Hills with uncompromised panoramic vistas of Kisumu City and Lake Victoria. Managed exclusively by Wangwana Agency, offering master en-suite bedrooms, open-plan architectural living, sunset veranda, and private grounds.

bedroomsDetail.name: Panoramic Master Suite

bedroomsDetail.name: Executive Bedroom 2

bedroomsDetail.name: Garden Bedroom 3
bedroomsDetail.features: Private Garden Terrace Access, Ideal for Family or Colleagues

policies.cancellation: 100% Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
policies.deposit: Zero deposit required. Pay upon check-in directly.
policies.payment: M-Pesa, Bank Transfer, or Cash upon arrival.
rules: Smoking allowed on outdoor terrace and gazebo only
Strict 10:00 PM quiet hours for neighborhood tranquility
Up to 6 registered guests; additional visitors by arrangement

reviews.text: The sunset view over Lake Victoria from the Riat Hills terrace is simply priceless. The kitchen is fully stocked, the beds are exceptionally comfortable, and the security team was polite and vigilant.
Wangwana exceeded every expectation. Beautiful architectural layout, standby generator that kicked in seamlessly during grid dips, and superb hospitality from host Blasio.

name: Dunga Beachfront Waterfront Villa
description: A waterfront sanctuary situated on the tranquil shores of Lake Victoria in Dunga. Managed by Wangwana Real Estate with private lakeside garden, outdoor entertaining terrace, private jetty access, and full security perimeter.

bedroomsDetail.name: Lakeside Master Suite
bedroomsDetail.features: French Doors opening onto Waterfront Lawn, Breezy Lake Air

bedroomsDetail.name: Twin Bedroom 3
bedroomsDetail.bath: Shared Bath with Guest Powder Room

policies.cancellation: 100% Free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to check-in.
rules: Children must be supervised near lakeside waters
Outdoor smoking permitted; no smoking in bedrooms
Eco-conscious lakeside living; quiet hours after 10:00 PM

reviews.text: Waking up to birds chirping over Lake Victoria and watching fishermen in the distance was magical. Dunga Hill Camp is just minutes away. Truly a slice of heaven in Kisumu.
Our family spent 5 days here. Safe for kids, pristine lawn, and the host team helped arrange fresh tilapia directly from the fishermen. Highly recommended!

name: Victoria Executive Corporate Suite
description: Tailor-crafted for corporate executives, medical consultants, and NGO travelers on short or extended assignments. Fully managed by Wangwana Agency in a private gated compound in Tom Mboya, minutes from the Kisumu CBD.

bedroomsDetail.name: Studio Suite
bedroomsDetail.features: Ergonomic Desk & Mesh Chair, Dual Monitor Space, High-Speed Fiber

policies.cancellation: 100% Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.
policies.payment: M-Pesa, Corporate LPO, Card, or Cash.

reviews.text: The fiber WiFi was rock solid (over 50 Mbps) which allowed smooth Zoom calls all week. Self check-in with the smart lock was super convenient after a delayed flight into Kisumu.
Clean, compact, and very quiet in Tom Mboya. Easy 5-minute commute to the CBD and Aga Khan Hospital. Will book again.
